name: iFAST Express
author: ifast

sections.description:
iFAST Express connects your WooCommerce shop to your iFAST Express account. From an iFAST page in your admin you open the iFAST console in its own browser tab, where you can:

  • see your orders and send them to iFAST, one by one, in bulk, or automatically;
  • print delivery labels;
  • follow the status and estimated delivery time of every delivery;
  • create deliveries that are not WooCommerce orders, and see all your deliveries in one dashboard.

The tracking number of each delivery is saved on its order. The plugin works with High-Performance Order Storage.

You need an iFAST Express account. The plugin does nothing until you click Connect on the iFAST page.

External services

This plugin connects your shop to the iFAST Express service, which runs the iFAST page and creates your deliveries. It is a required part of the plugin.

  • What it is: the iFAST Express service operated by iFAST Express (https://ifast.express).
  • What is sent, and when: only after an administrator clicks Connect on the iFAST page. Then the shop address, the WordPress, WooCommerce and plugin versions, and the details of your orders (customer name, phone, email, delivery address, order items, weights and amounts, payment method and status) are sent whenever an order is created or changes, so that the iFAST console can list them and send them for delivery. The console opens in its own browser tab on the service’s address, when an administrator clicks Open iFAST; nothing of it is shown inside your WordPress admin.
  • Products (iFAST Fulfilment shippers only, off until you allow it): if you use iFAST Fulfilment, the iFAST page can ask you to allow iFAST to read your published products (name, SKU, price, photo) and, separately, to set the stock quantity of linked products from your iFAST warehouse. Each is a button you press on the iFAST page of your shop and can turn off again at any time. Until then the service cannot read or change your products.
  • Why: to create and follow deliveries, print labels and show your orders next to their deliveries.
  • Stopping it: Disconnect on the iFAST page, deactivating or deleting the plugin stops all sharing.
  • Terms of service: https://ifast.express/en/terms-of-service
  • Privacy policy: https://ifast.express/en/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then this plugin.
  2. Open iFAST in the admin menu and click Connect to iFAST.
  3. Click Open iFAST. The iFAST console opens in a new tab: sign in there with your iFAST shipper code and API key.
sections.faq:
Does it work with High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes. The plugin only uses the WooCommerce order object.

Does iFAST get access to my WooCommerce API keys?

No. The plugin and the service talk through a small signed connection that can list orders and save a tracking number. Products are readable, and their stock changeable, only if you allow it on the iFAST page (iFAST Fulfilment shippers).
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First public release: connect your shop, send orders to iFAST, print labels, follow deliveries and see the tracking number on each order.
  • The iFAST console opens in its own browser tab (Open iFAST).
  • iFAST Fulfilment shippers can allow iFAST, separately and only if they choose, to read their products and to set the stock of linked products.
  • Works with WordPress 5.4 or newer and WooCommerce 5.0 or newer.

screenshots.caption: Send your WooCommerce orders to iFAST, print labels and track every delivery from one place.
Select orders, pick a delivery date and send them to iFAST in bulk.
Print delivery labels (AWB) for up to 50 orders at a time, in the size you choose.
Track every delivery live, with its full timeline and photos.
Instant international prices, in a light or navy theme, in English or Arabic.
